env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cat $GOROOT/VERSION
cp stdout $WORK/version.txt

logos version
cp stdout $WORK/logos-version.txt
exec grep -q -F -f $WORK/version.txt $WORK/logos-version.txt

env GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.99.0
logos version
cp stdout $WORK/toolchain-version.txt
exec grep -q -F -f $WORK/version.txt $WORK/toolchain-version.txt
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos help
logos help build
logos help run
logos help test
logos help vet
logos help eject
logos help lint
logos help next
logos help lsp
logos help context

logos build -o $WORK/hello$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/hello$GOEXE
stdout '^hello logos$'
logos run .
stdout '^hello logos$'
logos vet .
logos lint .
cd helper
logos test -count=1 .
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no tests to run'
cd ..
logos eject -o $WORK/ejected
exists $WORK/ejected/hello.go
cd $WORK/ejected
go build -o $WORK/ejected-hello$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/ejected-hello$GOEXE
stdout '^hello logos$'

! logos frobnicate
-- go.mod --
module example.com/command

go 1.27

-- hello.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func hello() string {
	return "hello logos"
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(hello())
}

-- helper/go.mod --
module example.com/helper

go 1.27

-- helper/hello.lgo --
package helper

func Hello() string {
	return "hello logos"
}

-- helper/hello_test.lgo --
package helper

import "testing"

func TestHello(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Hello(); got != "hello logos" {
		t.Fatalf("Hello() = %q", got)
	}
}
